public_definitions: The goal is to review the screening referral dashboard and assign this record to the operational follow-up pathway that best fits the referral pattern over the reporting period.
The chart shows 'Reduced Screening Referrals Across Hospitals from 2012 to 2023'.
The dashboard is the evidence source for selecting the appropriate screening referral follow-up pathway.
The three available options are: 'Route to growth-focused referral follow-up', 'Route to reduction-focused referral follow-up', and 'Route to standard referral monitoring'.
